about: search text becomes quoted terms with a prefix on the last, ranked by BM25
sql: SELECT o.id FROM fts CROSS JOIN search_text st ON st.doc = fts.rowid CROSS JOIN objects o ON o.id = st.object_id WHERE fts MATCH ? AND o.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY bm25(fts, 10.0, 1.0, 2.0), o.id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
